enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed doomscrolling YouTube and replying to WhatsApp messages, unable to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Picks up phone from bedside table. Unlocks phone. Opens YouTube app. Scrolls through video thumbnails. Taps on a video. Watches video. Scrolls to next video. Watches another video. Opens WhatsApp app. Reads messages. Types a reply. Sends reply. Continues scrolling YouTube. Watches more videos. Checks WhatsApp again. Types another reply. Sends. Turns off phone screen. Places phone on chest. Picks up phone again. Unlocks phone. Opens YouTube. Scrolls. Watches video. Turns off phone. Places phone on bedside table.

Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket up. Turns onto right side. Adjusts pillow. Stretches legs. Turns onto back. Pulls blanket down. Turns onto left side. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes. Continues sleeping. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Opens eyes. Sits up on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Rushing through a shower and wash, brushing teeth and getting dressed while already running late
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water. Steps in. Washes body. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Puts on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a quick breakfast and brewing a strong cup of tea, packing the laptop and studio supplies into a bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out milk and bread. Closes fridge. Puts bread in toaster. Fills kettle. Turns on kettle. Places tea bag in cup. Pours hot water. Adds milk. Eats toast. Packs laptop and supplies into bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Driving to Monash University Caulfield campus, stuck in morning traffic
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens car door. Sits in driver's seat. Closes door. Adjusts seat. Fastens seatbelt. Inserts key. Starts engine. Checks mirrors. Releases handbrake. Presses accelerator. Steers car. Presses brake. Stops at traffic light. Waits. Presses accelerator. Steers. Changes lane. Presses brake. Stops. Waits. Presses accelerator. Continues driving. Parks car. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Design studio class at Caulfield campus, working on critique and design development
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into studio. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Takes out notebook. Opens notebook. Picks up pen. Listens to instructor. Writes notes. Raises hand. Speaks. Shows design on screen. Listens to feedback. Nods. Writes more notes. Opens design software. Edits design file. Saves file. Closes laptop. Stands up. Walks to another student. Discusses project.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a dietary-restriction-friendly lunch on campus while scrolling the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to campus cafeteria. Stands in line. Orders lunch. Pays. Receives tray. Walks to table. Sits down. Unwraps food. Picks up fork. Eats food. Chews. Swallows. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens social media app. Scrolls. Takes another bite. Continues scrolling. Finishes meal. Puts down fork. Wipes mouth with napkin. Picks up tray. Returns tray. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on design project files in the campus library and attending a tutorial, with frequent tea breaks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into library. Finds seat. Sits down. Opens laptop. Opens design files. Edits graphics. Saves file. Stands up. Walks to café. Buys tea. Returns to seat. Drinks tea. Continues editing. Saves. Walks to tutorial room. Sits down. Listens. Takes notes. Participates in discussion. Returns to library. Continues working. Takes another tea break. Edits more files. Saves. Closes laptop.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens door. Sits. Closes door. Fastens seatbelt. Starts engine. Checks mirrors. Releases handbrake. Presses accelerator. Steers. Stops at light. Waits. Presses accelerator. Turns onto highway. Drives. Changes lane. Presses brake. Exits highway. Drives on local roads. Parks car. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and a snack, checking messages and rent or cleaning reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes cup from cupboard. Places tea bag in cup. Pours hot water. Adds milk. Opens pantry. Takes out snack. Eats snack. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens messages. Reads messages. Checks reminders app. Reads rent reminder. Closes phone. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch, working around the medical dietary restriction
enriched_activities.desc: Opens fridge. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes fridge. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables on cutting board. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds spices. Adds meat. Cooks. Stirs. Turns off stove. Takes plate. Serves food onto plate. Picks up plate. Walks to table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and wiping down the benches, clearing own dishes and shared space
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Eats dinner with fork. Drinks water. Finishes meal. Stands up. Picks up plate. Carries plate to sink. Rinses plate. Places plate in dishwasher. Picks up glass. Rinses glass. Places glass in dishwasher. Picks up cloth. Wets cloth. Wipes kitchen benches. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth. Washes hands. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance creative work at the computer and monitor, preparing illustration files for a client
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to desk. Sits on chair. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Opens illustration software. Creates new file. Sets canvas size. Picks up stylus. Draws sketch. Uses eraser. Adds layers. Colors illustration. Saves file. Exports file. Opens email. Attaches file. Sends email to client. Continues working on another illustration. Saves. Turns off computer. Turns off monitor. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching routine on the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Unrolls yoga mat. Sits on mat. Stretches arms forward. Bends forward. Holds stretch. Sits up. Stretches legs. Touches toes. Holds stretch. Lies on back. Pulls knees to chest. Rolls to side. Stands up. Rolls up mat.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and half-heartedly tidying up personal clutter in the shared space
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Flips channels. Stops on show. Watches. Stands up. Picks up magazines. Places magazines on shelf. Picks up clothes. Folds clothes. Places clothes in basket. Sits down. Watches more TV. Stands up. Picks up empty cup. Carries cup to kitchen. Returns. Sits down. Continues watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Night wash, skincare and changing into sleep clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies cleanser. Massages face. Rinses face. Pat dry with towel. Applies toner with cotton pad. Applies moisturizer. Brushes teeth. Applies toothpaste. Brushes. Rinses mouth. Spits. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom. Opens drawer. Takes out pajamas. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Walks back to bathroom. Hangs towel. Returns to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: In bed doomscrolling YouTube and WhatsApp, procrastinating on sleep despite an early class
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens YouTube. Scrolls. Watches video. Opens WhatsApp. Reads messages. Types reply. Sends. Switches back to YouTube. Watches another video. Scrolls. Watches. Checks WhatsApp again. Types reply. Sends. Turns off phone. Places phone on bedside table. Closes eyes. Turns onto side. Picks up phone again. Unlocks. Opens YouTube. Scrolls. Watches. Turns off phone. Places phone on table. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket.
